name: Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone
problem: Capability at sub-10B scale is dominated by parameter count and data volume, which makes such models too expensive to run on-device even though on-device deployment is where the latency and cost pressure actually is.
mechanism: Not an inference-time mechanism but a TRAINING-RECIPE argument: phi-3-mini is 3.8B parameters trained on 3.3 TRILLION tokens on a scaled-up version of the phi-2 dataset composed of heavily filtered public web data plus heavy SYNTHETIC data. The claim is that data QUALITY filtering and synthetic data generation substitute for scale. Also provides parameter-scaling results (7B/14B at 4.8T tokens) and a phi-3.5 series including phi-3.5-MoE (16 x 3.8B, 6.6B active parameters) and phi-3.5-Vision.
speedup_reported: Not a speedup claim. Capability at a given size: phi-3-mini achieves 69% MMLU and 8.38 MT-bench, rivaling Mixtral 8x7B and GPT-3.5, while being small enough to deploy on a phone. phi-3.5-MoE (6.6B active) is on par with Gemini-1.5-Flash and GPT-4o-mini. The INFERENCE-relevant claim is the on-device feasibility itself, which the abstract states qualitatively and does not quantify with a tok/s figure - so no mobile throughput number is recorded here because none is given.
notes: ADOPTION: in-production - weights are open (open_weights true) and phi-3-mini is genuinely deployed on phones and other constrained hardware, so this is one of the few records here where the artifact, not just the idea, is in production. VENUE NOTE: a self-described technical report with no venue; arXiv comment says only '24 pages', so venue = arxiv-preprint, year = ArXiv v1 (Apr 2024). INCLUDED AS THE SMALL-MODEL LINEAGE ANCHOR alongside MobileLLM and Mistral 7B because it makes the explicit trade this repo cares about: a smaller model at equal capability is a strictly cheaper inference, and at 3.8B the whole model fits a phone, which is the strongest possible version of the argument. The 3.3T-token training cost is the offsetting expense and is not itself quantified in energy terms here - for the carbon accounting, route via pap-eff-carbon-emissions-large-neural-training rather than expecting it in this record.
